value.rationale: The exact all-parameter classification isolates a surprising parity-dependent stabilization of fixed points whose local slope is less than −1, with a sharp quadratic decay of the coupling window as ring length increases through odd values. It also proves that two specific homogeneous sinks have open attraction basins in both of the source paper’s numerical phase-diagram regimes, a motivated structural caveat to single-seed numerical classifications. This is a mathematically complete natural local-invariant calculation, not a sample-specific incremental numerical improvement.
